notablePrerequisites: Nova Cleric does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, activate Nova Cleric by paying {2}{W}, tapping and sacrificing it, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.
